---
- name: Install the selinux python module
  ansible.builtin.dnf:
    name: libselinux-python
    state: present
  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"
- name: Copy the epel packages
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: epel.repo
    dest: /etc/yum.repos.d/epel_ansible.repo
    mode: "0644"
  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"
- name: Install the nginx packages
  ansible.builtin.dnf:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    state: present
  loop: "{{ redhat_pkg }}"
  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat"
- name: Install the nginx packages
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    state: present
    update_cache: true
  environment: "{{ env }}"
  loop: "{{ ubuntu_pkg }}"
  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "Debian"
- name: Create the directories for site specific configurations
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/nginx/{{ item }}
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - sites-available
    - sites-enabled
    - conf.d
- name: Create nginx log directory
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ nginx_log_dir }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
- name: Create site root directories
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: "{{ item['server']['root'] }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop: "{{ nginx_sites }}"
  when: nginx_sites|lower != 'none'
- name: Copy the nginx configuration file
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: nginx.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    mode: "0644"
  notify:
    - Restart nginx
- name: Copy the nginx default configuration file
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: default.conf.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
    mode: "0644"
- name: Copy the nginx default site configuration file
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: default.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-available/default
    mode: "0644"
- name: Create the link for site enabled specific configurations
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
    state: link
    src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/default
- name: Create the configurations for sites
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: site.j2
    dest: /etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item['server']['file_name'] }}
    mode: "0644"
  loop: "{{ nginx_sites }}"
  when: nginx_sites|lower != 'none'
- name: Create the links to enable site configurations
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ item['server']['file_name'] }}
    state: link
    src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item['server']['file_name'] }}
  loop: "{{ nginx_sites }}"
  when: nginx_sites|lower != 'none'
  notify:
    - Reload nginx
- name: Gather service facts
  ansible.builtin.service_facts:
- name: Start the nginx service
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: nginx
    state: started
    enabled: true

- name: Verify
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
  - name: Check if nginx configuration directories exist
    ansible.builtin.stat:
      path: '{{ item }}'
    register: nginx_dirs
    loop:
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-available
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-enabled
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/conf.d
    - /tmp/molecule_test/var/log/nginx
  - name: Assert nginx directories were created
    ansible.builtin.assert:
      that:
      - item.stat.exists
      - item.stat.isdir
      fail_msg: Directory {{ item.invocation.module_args.path }} not found
      success_msg: Directory {{ item.invocation.module_args.path }} exists
    loop: '{{ nginx_dirs.results }}'
  - name: Check if nginx configuration files exist
    ansible.builtin.stat:
      path: '{{ item }}'
    register: nginx_files
    loop:
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-available/default
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-available/foo
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-available/bar
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/yum.repos.d/epel_ansible.repo
  - name: Assert nginx configuration files were created
    ansible.builtin.assert:
      that:
      - item.stat.exists
      - item.stat.size > 0
      fail_msg: File {{ item.invocation.module_args.path }} not found or empty
      success_msg: File {{ item.invocation.module_args.path }} exists and has content
    loop: '{{ nginx_files.results }}'
  - name: Check if symbolic links exist
    ansible.builtin.stat:
      path: '{{ item }}'
    register: nginx_links
    loop:
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/foo
    - /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/bar
  - name: Assert symbolic links were created
    ansible.builtin.assert:
      that:
      - item.stat.exists
      - item.stat.islnk
      fail_msg: Symbolic link {{ item.invocation.module_args.path }} not found
      success_msg: Symbolic link {{ item.invocation.module_args.path }} exists
    loop: '{{ nginx_links.results }}'
  - name: Get nginx.conf content
    ansible.builtin.slurp:
      src: /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
    register: nginx_conf
  - name: Assert nginx.conf has expected content
    ansible.builtin.assert:
      that:
      - '''ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3'' in (nginx_conf.content | b64decode)'
      - '''worker_connections  512'' in (nginx_conf.content | b64decode)'
      fail_msg: nginx.conf does not contain expected configuration
      success_msg: nginx.conf contains expected configuration
  - name: Get site configuration content
    ansible.builtin.slurp:
      src: /tmp/molecule_test/etc/nginx/sites-available/foo
    register: site_conf
  - name: Assert site configuration has expected content
    ansible.builtin.assert:
      that:
      - '''listen 8080'' in (site_conf.content | b64decode)'
      - '''server_name localhost'' in (site_conf.content | b64decode)'
      - '''root /tmp/site1'' in (site_conf.content | b64decode)'
      fail_msg: Site configuration does not contain expected content
      success_msg: Site configuration contains expected content
  - name: Verify Nginx configuration
    ansible.builtin.command: nginx -t
    changed_when: false
    tags: molecule-notest
  - name: Check Nginx service status
    ansible.builtin.service_facts: null
    tags: molecule-notest
  - name: Assert Nginx service is running
    ansible.builtin.assert:
      that:
      - '''nginx.service'' in ansible_facts.services'
      - ansible_facts.services['nginx.service'].state == 'running'
      fail_msg: Nginx service is not running
      success_msg: Nginx service is running
    tags: molecule-notest
  - name: Test HTTP response
    ansible.builtin.uri:
      url: http://localhost
      status_code: 200
    tags: molecule-notest
